reason: The Book Safe, Pay on Delivery thing and the low 5% fee are genuinely well thought out, but the moment I opened this I thought exactly what the app itself admits -- the numbers near me might still be close to zero while they onboard their first batch. I don't let a stranger into my house to fix something or do a facial just because an app says they're verified; I ask my neighbour or a relative first, and an app with thin supply in my area doesn't change that habit.
objection: Will there actually be enough decent freelancers near me with real history, or will I open it and find one or two people with barely any completed jobs -- meaning I'm the guinea pig, not a customer.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see, for my specific area in Chennai/Coimbatore, a handful of freelancers with solid completed-job counts and ratings before I even try to book -- not a citywide number, and not 'still building up' -- I'd download it and try one small, low-risk job like tutoring or beauty first.
